name: Claude Smart Webhook AI Router
description: Routes incoming webhook requests by Anthropic Claude AI classification. Claude analyzes each payload and routes to support, technical, sales, or general handler.

blockers.detail: Chat Model provider anthropic is not supported by the current node catalog

setup: "Claude Classifier": the original provider "anthropic" and model are preserved. Select a supported Chat Model provider and matching model, or add its adapter in Yantra before running.
"Incoming Webhook" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers, llm_system_421ffc3289.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /ai-router). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.

"Claude Classifier" called the Anthropic API (claude-haiku-4-5) over HTTP; it now runs on LLMChain with a Chat Model and provider connector credential, and later steps read the answer text instead of the provider's JSON.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
